Locations in the Stamp operated by Dining Services accept cash, credit and debit cards, Dining Dollars and Terrapin Express.

Note: Panda Express, Moby Freestyle, and Hibachi San are open in the Stamp but their hours are not listed here. These locations are not managed by Dining Services, and we may not have access to their current hours. Find their hours here instead
